generation_stage: registered and materialized before observed metrics

primary_survival_family.rule: multiply every finite raw PM2.5 value by 0.95
multiply every finite raw PM2.5 value by 1.05
add deterministic zero-mean Gaussian noise with sigma 0.01 times the station finite raw PM2.5 MAD, floor negative results at zero
starting at the first timestamp, mark hours 0 through 5 missing every 30th local day
starting at the first date, mark every 90th complete local day missing

diagnostic_family.rule: within each year-month, deterministically select floor(0.10*d/2) disjoint day pairs and swap complete day records
use the preregistered cyclic adjacency score without changing values

null_policy_under_perturbation: apply the same perturbation rule to each parent-local raw series, then generate the registered matched null children from that perturbed series
